_comment: Blog / content niche (business blog, not news wire). Auto-detected on Article/BlogPosting schema or author/byline. Full param reference: ../blog-method/BLOG-PARAMETERS-2026-2027.md. is_local:false so page-level local checks (LocalBusiness schema, map/directions) are skipped for articles.
_na_comment: Params that describe a sales/landing page, not an informational article. Excluded from the score (not auto-passed) — a blog post legitimately has no lead form, demo CTA, sticky CTA, testimonials block, team/founder block, case studies, or multi-section landing layout. Article E-E-A-T comes from the author bio + sources + dates, which ARE required above.
